name: Vapin Ape Full Spectrum Disposable | Pineapple Haze
description: This sativa hybrid strain is cultivated by crossing Skunk#1, Afghan, and Old School Haze. This strain is high in uplifting terpenes like Limonene, Ocimene, Terpinolene that together create equally enticing tropical flavors and upbeat effects. Users report a creative and energetic spark, making it ideal for day time use.
